As implemented in the genuine engine: sends a fake ClientHello probe with the Fake SNI on a side connection, then sends the real hello split at the SNI. With the TTL toggle on, the probe uses the engine\'s TTL-trick path. (This build uses regular sockets — no raw-packet injection and no root.)
Fake-hello probe (when TTL trick is on) plus fragmentation of the real ClientHello with your strategy and delay. The original program\'s recommended method.

Manjaniq is a local TLS proxy controller for the genuine RSTA SNI Spoof engine. It runs the original engine on this device and exposes its configuration, live statistics and logs — it does not redirect device traffic and needs no root.
RSTA SNI Spoof engine and its genuine bypass strategies; Android Jetpack (Compose, Startup, Test); Kotlin; Go.
This build uses regular sockets — no raw-packet injection and no root.
